source.note: Category, feature, and service-description data ported from simslim. Regenerate from upstream when simslim revises its allowlist.

categories.name: Widgets & Wallpaper
categories.description: Home and lock screen posters, widgets, and Live Activities.
categories.downside: Home and Lock Screen widgets, wallpaper posters, and Live Activities stop updating.

categories.name: Siri & Intelligence
categories.description: Siri, Apple Intelligence, speech, and on-device ML model services.
categories.downside: Siri, speech features, and Apple Intelligence services are unavailable.

categories.name: Spotlight & Search
categories.description: On-device Spotlight and in-Settings search services.
categories.downside: Spotlight and Settings search return no results.

categories.name: iCloud & Apple Account
categories.description: iCloud sync, Apple Account, keychain, and backup services.
categories.downside: iCloud sync, Apple Account, Keychain, and backup workflows will not work.

categories.name: App Store, Push & Media
categories.description: App Store, push notification, StoreKit, and media services.
categories.downside: Remote push notifications and StoreKit or App Store testing will not work.

categories.name: Mail, Calendar & Contacts
categories.description: Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, and related sync services.
categories.downside: Contacts, Calendar, Reminders, and Mail-backed pickers or sync may fail.

categories.name: Safari Sync & Web Services
categories.description: Safari sync, web push, privacy, and universal-link services.
categories.downside: Universal links and Safari sync or background web services will not work.

categories.name: Family & Screen Time
categories.description: Family Sharing, Screen Time, and usage tracking.
categories.downside: Family Sharing, Screen Time, and usage tracking stop working.

categories.name: Health, Home & Fitness
categories.downside: HealthKit, HomeKit, and Fitness integrations will not work.

categories.name: Photos & Media Analysis
categories.description: Photos library, photo analysis, and media analysis services.
categories.downside: Photo picker, Photos-library workflows, and media analysis may fail.

categories.name: News, Weather, Maps & Games
categories.description: News, Weather, Maps, Tips, and game services.
categories.downside: News, Weather, Maps background data, and game-controller services are unavailable.

categories.name: Messaging & FaceTime
categories.description: iMessage, FaceTime, call, and identity services.
categories.downside: iMessage, FaceTime, and related identity services will not work.

categories.name: Sharing & Device Connectivity
categories.description: AirDrop, Continuity, CarPlay, Watch, and Find My services.
categories.downside: AirDrop, Continuity, CarPlay, Watch, and Find My connectivity will not work.

categories.name: Ads, Diagnostics & Telemetry
categories.description: DeviceCheck, ad privacy, analytics, diagnostics, and feedback services.
categories.downside: DeviceCheck plus analytics, diagnostics, and feedback services are unavailable.

categories.name: Other Background Services
categories.description: Wallet, business services, assets, and miscellaneous background daemons.
categories.downside: Wallet, merchant, business, asset, and miscellaneous background services are unavailable.
